risk_note: RV2 by path (payment). Pay reconciliation daily scheduling (BR-PAY-07 T+1; B2-15j follow-ups): after bootstrap the worker seeds bill.recon per App with any pay order or anomaly (B1-22b slot chain on queue pay: 15 s first seed, re-seed every 5 minutes, unref, singletonKey App + bill date), starting at the +08:00 accounting day of the App's earliest pay order / anomaly; the next daily run is derived from the reconciled bill date + 1 and enqueued before the channels are reconciled, so downtime, dead-letter replays and failed catch-up sends never skip a day; catch-up runs leave the chain alone; reconciliation judgement, amounts and dedupe keys unchanged. Orders wiring tests narrowed to orders' own timers / queries by the prerequisite test-change #1666 (D10-363). No migration, no contract change.
